morning.caption:
Texas Pacific Land agreed to buy EagleRock Land in an all-stock deal worth about $3 billion, adding 59,000 acres and Midland Basin water assets. Combined water sourcing and treatment capacity rises to about 1.5 million barrels a day.

Full edition: watercapitalwire.com

afternoon.caption:
California Water Service Group finalized $275 million of private placement debt, with coupons from 6.08% to 6.54%, to refinance existing debt. The utility serves more than 2.2 million people and becomes Watermark Utilities on November 30.

More: watercapitalwire.com

evening.caption:
The UN General Assembly agreed by consensus to hold a global water conference every three years from 2031, in a resolution led by the UAE and Senegal. The 2026 conference opens in Abu Dhabi on December 8.
